raw_text: Cache Storage API Calls (LOW-MEDIUM): `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, and `document.cookie` are synchronous and expensive. Cache reads in memory. Use a Map (not a hook) so it works everywhere: utilities, event handlers, not just React components. Keep cache in sync on writes. If storage can change externally (another tab, server-set cookies), invalidate cache: on `storage`, delete `e.key`; on visible `visibilitychange`, refresh cookie cache.
